findings.finding: All eight NRG Pizza (Pizza Hut) units Prisma leased went dark with the 9 Sep bankruptcy (chain's 18 restaurants closed), so the earnings capacity at 1 Oct will exclude ~1.7% of rental income (~SEK 12m/yr of SEK 713m, ~3.5% of the SEK 347m profit-from-property-management capacity), likely leaving it below the ~2.21 SEK/share Q3 point the company's own Q2 chart pre-signalled, with a possible write-down on the QSR units.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The bankruptcy day itself (2026-09-09) closed -3.68% from 27.20 to 26.20; the stock is 26.40 now, still below the pre-news close. No prior earnings-capacity miss to compare.
findings.original_quote: "Kedjans 18 svenska restauranger är nu stängda och omkring 250 anställda berörs." (The chain's 18 Swedish restaurants are now closed and around 250 employees are affected.) -- Finwire via Placera, https://www.placera.se/telegram/pizza-hut-i-sverige-i-konkurs--18-restauranger-stangda-20260909; and Prisma: "hyresintäkterna från NRG Pizza ... motsvarade cirka 1,7 procent av Prismas totala hyresintäkter per den 30 juni 2026" (rental income from NRG Pizza corresponded to about 1.7% of Prisma's total rental income at 30 June 2026), https://www.placera.se/telegram/prisma-properties-pizza-hut-stod-for-1-7-av-totala-hyresintakter-30-6-20260909
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced: the stock fell 3.7% the day it was published and has not recovered the pre-news level. What may be left is the translation into the earnings-capacity number, which is a mechanical calculation three analysts can do; if it were fully priced there would be nothing left of it, which is roughly the size given.
findings.independence: Placera/Finwire closure report from a different source (Dagens industri reading the Stockholm district court documents): https://www.placera.se/telegram/pizza-hut-i-sverige-i-konkurs--18-restauranger-stangda-20260909

findings.finding: Three acquisitions announced since Q2 carry the company's own stated per-share accretion (Værløse +0.58%, Hvidovre +0.18%, Pietarsaari forward purchase +0.73% from Sep 2027), partly offsetting the NRG vacancy in the updated earnings capacity; all inside the growth path the company already charted.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Earnings-capacity growth has been reported every quarter (1.13 -> 2.11 SEK/share over Q3 24 -> Q2 26) and report-day reactions were +0.4% to +2.5% on six of seven observed prints; the market has been told each step in advance.
findings.why_not_priced: It is priced: each deal was released with its accretion figure. Filed because it bears on the one line that is new in the release; sized at near zero because it lands inside what the company already guided.
findings.independence: Værløse release https://view.news.eu.nasdaq.com/view?id=bd3d58704040ce8a851ee03b5fe35bb5c&lang=en&src=listed and Pietarsaari release https://view.news.eu.nasdaq.com/view?id=bd967d03dea597f6b32faafbd802920fb&lang=en&src=listed (same issuer, different documents)

findings.finding: The issuer is the largest visible buyer of its own stock: ~34,000 shares (~SEK 0.87m) a day in week 42 under a Safe Harbour programme run by ABG Sundal Collier that kept buying inside the pre-report closed period, against median daily turnover of ~SEK 1.9m, with ~SEK 95m of the SEK 140m programme still unspent.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Since the buyback pace was doubled on 2026-09-08 the stock has held 25-26.5 SEK through the NRG Pizza bankruptcy; five-day run-up +3.5% into the print.
findings.why_not_priced: Known flow, so not information; but a programmed buyer worth close to half of daily volume is a mechanical dampener on a negative reaction in a $200k/day name, so the downside tail on report day is thinner than the upside. If the market had fully absorbed this, the stock would not still sit at ~78% of the reported NAV of 33.8 SEK.

findings.finding: Prisma said in July it signed a letter of intent for its largest building right (Kungens kurva) and aims to sign a binding long lease 'this autumn'; if the Q3 report announces it, that is the one strategic item that could add to the earnings-capacity path.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: LOI release on 2026-07-06 (16:00 CEST) preceded the Q2 print; no clean isolated reaction measurable.
findings.original_quote: "Parterna har påbörjat arbetet med att formalisera avsiktsförklaringen och ambitionen är att ingå ett bindande hyresavtal under hösten 2026." (The parties have begun formalising the letter of intent and the ambition is to sign a binding lease during autumn 2026.)
findings.why_not_priced: The LOI is public, so a signing is partly expected; whether it lands with this report or later in the autumn is not known, so only a fraction of its value is carried here. Construction start is not before Q3 2027, so even a signing is a long-dated earnings item.
findings.independence: Company's own Q2 report repeats the ambition ('working purposefully towards signing a long-term lease this autumn'): https://attachment.news.eu.nasdaq.com/a8cd6bab3ffbe39659f0bff7c95884770

baseline_tension: Agrees with a flat lean (priced_lean +0.07, 20d run-up -1.5%, 5d +3.5%): the findings net to roughly zero, slightly positive on the buyback flow and the name's habit of drifting up on report days, against a public tenant loss already marked down.
language_note: Finwire/Placera (citing Dagens industri and the Stockholm district court papers) reported that all 18 Swedish Pizza Hut restaurants were closed on bankruptcy day, three hours before Prisma's own release, which only said re-letting efforts had begun; that is what makes the vacancy (not a continuing tenant) the right reading for the earnings-capacity update.
The Swedish wire copy of the Kungens kurva LOI carried the explicit 'bindande hyresavtal under hösten 2026' timetable; the English release carries the same, so it adds nothing new.
Otherwise nothing the English sources did not already carry: every Prisma release is dual-language on the Nasdaq Nordic feed and the Swedish press had no Q3 preview.

'A finding about a number the market has already been told is worth 0' / landing inside the guide: the accretive-acquisitions finding cut from +0.10 to +0.05
